rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition/Permanent Removal, Temporary Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, with amounts varying by year and enhanced payments for elderly, disabled, or households with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant (3/01/26-2/28/27); $24,733.00 max per unit; $5,497.00 additional for elderly/disabled/minor children
rules.exemption_note: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Ellis Act relocation payments)
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.summary: Landlords must pay relocation assistance to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, with higher amounts than other no-fault evictions and enhanced payments for elderly or disabled tenants.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant (3/01/26-2/28/27); $33,330.13 max per unit; $7,443.90 additional for elderly/disabled
rules.exemption_note: Elderly threshold is 62 years or older for Ellis Act evictions (versus 60 for other no-fault evictions)
